statements.t: We believe our product revenue will increase as we complete development and obtain regulatory clearance for our product candidates and secure opportunities to manufacture third party products with silicon nitride.

We expect to incur additional research and development costs as we continue to develop new medical devices, related product candidates for antipathogenic applications, and other products which may increase our total research and development expenses.
Management expects its OEM manufacturing operations and proprietary medical technology initiatives to remain complementary components of the Company's long-term growth strategy.

While the Company expects its pricing initiatives and continued focus on higher-margin sales to support profitability, gross margins may fluctuate from period to period based on product mix, pricing, manufacturing efficiencies, customer demand, and the mix of product and grant and contract revenue.
The condensed consolidated financial statements have been prepared assuming we will continue to operate as a going concern.
We expect to continue incurring operating losses and using cash in operations as we advance our commercialization initiatives.

We continue to evaluate opportunities to raise additional capital through equity and/or debt financing; however, there can be no assurance that additional funding will be available on acceptable terms, if at all.
We continue to pursue initiatives intended to strengthen our financial position through increased commercial activity, improved operating efficiencies, and disciplined cost management.

Management expects continued demand for our OEM products at levels above those experienced in prior periods, although quarterly sales volumes may fluctuate based on the timing and size of customer orders.

Additionally, in October 2025, we entered into a sublease agreement for the SINTX Armor facility, which is expected to generate approximately $1.0 million in savings over the sublease term, as discussed in Note 12 to the condensed consolidated financial statements.
We received approximately $1.5 million in cash and expect to receive approximately $0.2 million in deferred purchase price upon collection, subject to contractual adjustments.

estimates.t: A summary of our significant accounting policies and estimates is discussed in Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations and in Note 1 to our consolidated financial statements included in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025.

dropped.t: The result exceeds the high end of the Company’s previously announced guidance of $0.9 million to $1.1 million, reflecting stronger-than-expected industrial ceramics sales, and is expected to result in narrower losses than previous quarters.
The Company reiterates its fourth-quarter revenue guidance range offered during its last quarterly earnings call.

“In addition to the significantly narrowed losses we expect to see as a result of these sales and nearly doubling the high end of the guidance we provided in August, our 2026 third-quarter revenue represents growth of roughly 380% from the second quarter, and over ten times the revenue from the prior year quarter.”

Concurrent with issuing this press release on Form 8-K, the Company also intends to deliver a Call Notice to the holders of Class B Warrants to purchase an aggregate of approximately 1.88 million shares of the Company’s Common Stock.

This outlook is based on current production schedules, customer requirements and management’s expectations regarding manufacturing execution, shipments and the timing of revenue recognition.
